register: Respectful Korean; existing 해요/하십시오 help, concise noun/action labels; source-method self-questions retain their existing form.
reviewer: Codex Korean language agent (AI, not human native-speaker approval)
scope: All 4,016 locale string leaves individually read in nine namespaces, including retained/legacy labels and every Korean _other count form. Ledger serialization followed the reading; statuses are editorial decisions, not fingerprint-derived review. Source code/hardcoded surface audit and runtime screens are tracked by the coordinating agent. Three new source-location labels were subsequently individually reviewed and added (4,019 final leaves). Native audit added two format labels and nineteen unsupported-book diagnostic labels, individually adjudicated (4,040 final leaves). Three additional generated-PPTX display/accessibility names were individually reviewed (4,043 final leaves). Three generated-Word custom-style display names were subsequently read and added (4,046 final leaves).
